title: SPI service descriptor (schema v3 and v4)
description: Fork-owned service and acceptance contract at .spi/service.yaml. Schema v3 remains the Java/Maven contract. Schema v4 adds source-based Node/TypeScript and Python/FastAPI Azure archetypes plus argv-safe script suites. Bindings remain symbolic and are resolved per run against the stack facts envelope. The resolver engine (.github/actions/acceptance-resolver) is the authority on enforcement.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Version 3 is Java/Maven-only. Version 4 adds source-based services and script acceptance suites.

archetype.description: Build/test archetype. Source-based Node and Python archetypes require schemaVersion 4.

sourcePath.description: Repository-relative package root. Required for source-based archetypes.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js version supplied to actions/setup-node. Required for node-typescript-azure.

pythonVersion.description: Python version supplied to actions/setup-python. Required for python-fastapi-azure.

image.description: Source-based service image inputs. Required for Node and Python archetypes.

tests.description: Named suites of one shape. acceptance is required and is the upstream <svc>-acceptance-test by default; a fork adds others, for example integration for its provider suite. The acceptance image bakes every declared suite path.

source.description: Closed source vocabulary. Facts: gateway (base_url), partition (primary partition name), openid (OIDC v2.0 issuer URL, published explicitly by the stack), tenant (azure.tenant_id), legalTag (primary partition's legal_tag), domain (the entitlements domain the stack deployed, published as entitlements_domain). keyvault:<name> reads that secret from the stack's vault. static carries the declared value; template renders ${NAME} references to other (non-template, non-secret) bindings after everything else resolves; user must be supplied by the caller's environment; token is the bearer the caller minted for this run, supplied as RESOLVER_TOKEN; memberToken is the bearer minted for the stack's member identity, a plain user with no admin rights, supplied as RESOLVER_MEMBER_TOKEN; noAccessToken is the bearer minted for the stack's no-access identity, supplied as RESOLVER_NO_ACCESS_TOKEN. Anything else is a hard failure naming the key.

suffix.description: Appended to a fact-sourced value (gateway values have their trailing slash stripped first). Fact sources only.

value.description: Required for static and template sources; invalid elsewhere.

default.description: Fallback when the fact or caller environment does not supply an answer. Invalid for keyvault, token, memberToken, and noAccessToken sources (a default secret would put a secret value in the repository) and for static/template.

type.description: maven is available in schema v3 and v4. script requires schemaVersion 4.

path.description: Repository-relative working directory of the suite, e.g. the upstream <svc>-acceptance-test module.

mavenArguments.description: Individual Maven argv tokens. Consumers pass the decoded array directly to Maven and never evaluate it as a shell string.

entrypoint.description: Executable path relative to the suite path. Required for script suites.

arguments.description: Script argv tokens. Consumers pass each item as one argument and never evaluate a shell string. A ${NAME} environment placeholder must occupy the complete token.

reportPaths.description: JUnit XML globs relative to the suite directory. Required for script suites so a zero exit with no tests cannot pass.

bindings.description: Environment variables the suite reads, each bound to a symbol from the closed source vocabulary -- never to an environment value. Resolution precedence per variable: explicit process environment (verbatim) -> source resolution -> declared default. template sources render last.

keyVaultBindings.description: Environment variable to Key Vault secret NAME, resolved from the stack's vault at run time. Secret values never appear in the descriptor.

loads.description: Named data loads the environment must have seeded (checked against published load facts by the deploy gate).

groups.description: Entitlement groups the test caller must hold.

dependencies.description: Sibling services this suite calls; a pinned dependency blocks the deploy gate with a typed reason.
